full_judgment: 4. The said accused Abdur Rahim filed an application for re-instatement in the service to Messrs Kohinoor Chemical Industries Limited under section 3(3) of the Public Servants (dismissal on conviction) Ordinance but his application was not considered. He filed IRO Case No. 5 of 1981 and the Labour Court dismissed the case initially only on the ground of limitation. The said Abdur Rahim made representation to Messrs Kohinoor Chemical Industries as well as Bangladesh Chemical Industries Corporation and also to the Chief Martial Law Administrator for his reinstatement but in vain. Then accused worker filed a representation to the petitioner who was then in charge of the Ministry of Industries and he recommended for his reinstatement and accordingly, he has been reinstated and thus the corporation suffered a loss of Taka 2,08,623 and the accused persons committed the offence under sections 409/109 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act.
